name: Kendal Brown
role: Manager, Corporate Automation and Digital Manufacturing, Eastman
bio: Kendal Brown is the Manager of Corporate Automation and Digital Manufacturing for Eastman Chemical Company. Kendal began his career with Eastman in 2007 at their Longview, Texas site where he served as a chemical engineer and advanced to Area Manager roles in Acetaldehyde and Texanol departments. In 2016, Kendal transferred to Eastman’s headquarters in Kingsport, Tennessee as Americas North Manufacturing Optimization Manager. Kendal holds a B.S. degree in chemical engineering from the University of Arkansas.
